raw_response:
My plot is very small, only 0.13 hectares here in Lindi, and I grow nuts (cashew mostly, intercropped with cassava or legumes as we do here). I cannot afford chemical fertilizer — the price is too high and for cashew we mostly rely on the trees themselves, maybe a little manure from the goats. I will use my own seed from last season, and I will try to spray once against the powdery mildew and helopeltis that damage the cashew, because without spraying the harvest is very poor. There is no irrigation here, we depend on the rains, and I will do the work myself with some help from my family.
